Basada en la clásica historia del autor latinoamericano Juan Rulfo, este melodrama narra la vida de Dionisio Pinzón, un campesino muy pobre que vive en un pequeño pueblo mexicano con su madre. Cuando le regalan un gallo moribundo, Dionisio se interesa en jugar. Con su gallo ya recuperado, busca su fortuna en las ferias campesinas. Esta obra de Arturo Ripstein es en parte un homenaje al trabajo de Buñuel en México

Based on a classic story by Latin American literature master Juan Rulfo, this drama tells the story of Dionisio Pinzón, a poor peasant living in a small Mexican town with his mother. He becomes interested in cock fighting when he is given an injured gamecock; together they set off to find their fortune in cockfights and gambling. This profound film by Arturo Ripstein is in part an homage to Buñel's work in Mexico

"La problematica de la naturaleza humana, en torno a personajes victimas, tanto de las circunstancias en que estan inmersos, como de sus propias contradicciones y debilidades. Arrastran conflictos del pasado que asfixian su presente y cancelan las perspectivas del futuro. A traves del filme los personajes adquieren una belleza y dimension tragicas, casi miticas"--Filmoteca de la UNAM website

The problems of human nature surround the characters, victims of the circumstances in which they are immersed, of their own contradictions and weaknesses. Dogged by past conflicts that stifle their present and limit their future prospects, the film imbues the characters with a certain beauty and a tragic, almost mythical dimension-- Adapted from the Spanish synopsis
